notes: Adds persistence, audit, and cross-service integration stories for consent workflow completeness.

change_log.value: Lead capture integration with consent tiers

stories.title: Consent Persistence Schema and Storage
stories.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema for storing consent records, including tier level, timestamp, user/session linkage, and revocation state. Ensure compatibility with de-identification requirements.

stories.title: Consent Audit Logging
stories.description: Implement audit logging for all consent actions (create, upgrade, downgrade, revoke) including timestamp and triggering context. Logs must support compliance review without exposing raw PII.

stories.title: Lead Capture Integration with Consent Tiers
stories.description: Integrate consent workflow with lead_capture service to ensure that PII is only stored when Tier 2 consent is granted and blocked or de-identified under Tier 1.
